description: Use this when the user wants an AI influencer or a character for a product, brand, campaign, ad or post and hasn't picked one. Pass the brief (what it is, for whom, where it will be posted) and get the BudgetPixel AI influencers who fit it best, each with why, a content idea and a ready-to-use prompt that starts with their @handle (pass it to generate_image or generate_video). include_mine also considers the user's own characters. Free.

brief.description: What the content is, for whom and where it will be posted, e.g. "a 10-second TikTok ad for a protein shake aimed at gym beginners". Up to 1,000 characters.

include_mine.description: Also consider the user's own and collected characters (default false: BudgetPixel influencers only).
